captions.detailed: A ladder-frame fixture constructed with a dark gray vertical frame resembling a four-rung ladder. Attached to the outer vertical rails are two stub arms on distinct cheek blocks: a lower, shorter arm on the left side, and a higher, longer arm on the right. The arms are colored orange-brown and are designed to rotate independently as separate revolute joints on their respective support blocks.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a ladder-frame two-branch fixture. The model should feature a dark gray central ladder-like frame supporting two unevenly placed cheek blocks on opposite sides, each holding an orange-brown stub arm capable of rotating as an independent revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main ladder frame by using box primitives for the vertical rails and horizontal rungs. Create two separate cheek blocks as thin rectangular plates positioned at different heights on either side of the ladder. Model the two stub arms of different lengths using extruded or box geometry with chamfered ends, and define two revolute joint articulations connecting each arm to its corresponding cheek block.
